column1: # Luxel partition table (4 MB flash). No factory partition: this device has
# no distinct golden image — the serially-flashed build is the same one that
# ships over OTA — so factory was 1 MB of dead weight. Instead we run pure
# A/B: serial flash lands in ota_0
# OTA slots ever fail the bootloader falls back to ota_0 (its default when no
# factory partition exists). The freed 1 MB becomes `storage`
